definitions.explanation: The act of devoting all one's strength and effort to achieving something. A formal term often used in business and official contexts.

examples.japanese: ご{尽力|じんりょく}⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{尽力|じんりょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To make every effort for success.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}{解決|かいけつ}→問題解決：26071_mondaikaiketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{尽力|じんりょく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧まいります⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: We are working hard to resolve the issue, so please wait a little longer.

notes:
{尽力|じんりょく} is a formal term for making great effort or exerting oneself.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ご{尽力|じんりょく}⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧ (for your efforts - honorific)
- {尽力|じんりょく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧まいります (I/we will do our best - humble)
- {尽力|じんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{惜|お}しまない→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧ (spare no effort)

USAGE NOTE: More formal than ⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧ or ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧. Often used in business correspondence and formal speeches to acknowledge or promise dedicated effort.
